notes.title: [Notice] 3/14 PDT Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

For today's announcement, we would like to share information regarding the update.
As many have been waiting for a long time, the ACT 3 has finally been updated.
We expect the ACT 3 to provide more fun than ACT 1 and ACT 2.
Also, the Magiax story will continue and will constantly be updated in the future.

Please see below for the update details.

Update Contents:

1. ACT 3 Added

2. DLC Characters Changes
> The DLC characters have been changed to be FREE for all users. 

3. Morgan Character Balance
> All of Morgan's skill damage has been increased.

4. Caleera's Blazing Hellfire II Damange Balance
> Caleera's Blazing Hellfire II skill damage has been reduced.

5. Xbox One Pad Error Issue Resolved.
> The issue where the game would not read the Xbox One pad upon connecting the controller has been resolved.

6. Xbox One Pad Key Display Issue Resolved.
> The issue where the key display would not display correct in the key customization screen when using the Xbox One Pad has been resolved.

7. An issue where the Control Pad would not work during specific UI has been resolved.

8. An issue where the system would execute upgrade twice when upgrading the gear for the first time with the controller pad has been resolved.

Thank you.

tags.balance_change: 4. Caleera's Blazing Hellfire II Damange Balance

tags.bug: 5. Xbox One Pad Error Issue Resolved.
6. Xbox One Pad Key Display Issue Resolved.
7. An issue where the Control Pad would not work during specific UI has been resolved.
8. An issue where the system would execute upgrade twice when upgrading the gear for the first time with the controller pad has been resolved.

notes.title: [Announcement] 2/25 PST Official Full Version Release Notice
notes.content:
Greetings Everyone,

We have a special announcement that everyone has been waiting for!

The MagiaX Official Full Version has been released on Steam on 2/25 00:00 AM PST!

The Full Version includes the following 

1. Story Campaign until Act 2
- The Act 3 is currently on the verge of completing the QA, thus will be added very soon in the future. 

2. 4 Characters (2 DLC Characters)
- Aiden Rueran
- Caleera 
- Leta Vinis (DLC)
- Morgan von Shill (DLC)
* DLC characters can be purchased in the MagiaX Steam Store. 
* DLC characters may take couple of hours to show up on the Steam Store due to Steam Submission and Review. 

3. Controller Pad Support
- The controller pad support has been added in the Full Version.

** Special Note **

We are preparing a special contest to celebrate the Full Version Release.
You will have a chance to win Steam Gift Cards in the special contest so make sure to check the discussion in the near future for details! 

Thank you!

tags.feature: 3. Controller Pad Support - The controller pad support has been added in the Full Version.

notes.title: [Announcement] 1/4 Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Happy 2021 and we hope that everyone had a wonderful New Year!

For today's announcement, we would like to notify everyone about the 1/4 update and its contents.

Please check the update content below.

[b]Update[/b]

1. Chapter 2 Added

2. Quality of Life Change for Skill Runes
> Feature to select the quantity upon using the Skill Rune Added

3. Quality of Life Change for Selling Material Items
> Feature to select the quantity upon Selling Gear Materials Added

4.  Window Mode and Window Size
> Window Mode and Window Size can be adjusted and set in the Menu.

5.  Bug Fix
> An issue where the "Controller" input would react upon pressing the "D" Button on the Keyboard has been resolved.

6. Boss Entry Animation Removed.
> The Boss entry animation has been removed from Normal & Hard stages.

[b]Skill Balance [/b]

1. Owl Dive
> The skill, Owl Dive, type 1 and 2 skill cooldowns have been adjusted.
A.  Owl Dive - Type 1
- Previous: 19 Second Cooldown
- [u]New: 17 Second Cooldown[/u]

B. Owl Dive - Type 2
- Previous: 18 Second Cooldown
- [u]New: 20 Second Cooldown[/u]

2. Sharpraid
> The skill, Sharpraid, basic and type 2 skill cooldowns have been adjusted.
A.  Sharpraid - Basic
- Previous: 18 Second Cooldown
- [u]New: 17 Second Cooldown[/u]

B. Sharpraid - Type 2
- Previous: 19 Second Cooldown
- [u]New: 21 Second Cooldown[/u]


Thank you.

notes.title: Update on Dec.04 2020
notes.content:
Hello, 
Please check the update content below.

1. Key customization feature added. 
> Due to the key customization feature, the in-game "key guide button" and “key guide” in the setting have been removed. 

2. Gear Stat display changes 
> The Gear stat will now display in form of "regular stat + enhanced stat"

3. Mobility changes in the town
> You will be able to move left and right in the town by placing the mouse on either side of the screen

4. Scroll Bar Feature Changes
> The scroll bar feature has been added to several contents and can be used with mouse scroll button. The following contents will now contain the scroll bar feature: Equipment, World Map List, Sub-Quest Log, and etc. 

5. Act 1 Normal and Hard Difficulty Rewards per stage Adjustment


Thank you.
